Uddhav Thackeray Demands Disqualification of Rebel Shiv Sena MPs

Shiv Sena chief Uddhav Thackeray has demanded the immediate disqualification of six party MPs who defected to the Eknath Shinde-led faction, amid a power struggle within the party. The move comes as Uddhav seeks to maintain his position and prevent Eknath Shinde from becoming the new leader of the Shiv Sena. This development is part of a larger power struggle between Uddhav and Eknath Shinde, with both sides vying for control of the party.
